summary: A.S., 37, hiking alone in Rocky Mountain National Park; search began Aug 4 after he failed to return; car found at Corral Creek Trailhead; body spotted by helicopter below a cliff band above Mirror Lake; multiple blunt force injuries, cause undetermined.
location: above Mirror Lake (below cliff band), Rocky Mountain National Park
notes: NPS ROMO morning-report compendium entry. Corral Creek Trailhead is on the west side (NW portion of park); county Grand. Run-585 merge: NPS Aug-6-2019 release (parent-opened) corroborates — body believed to be Aragorn Spaulding, 37, of Greeley located by aerial searchers in steep scree above Mirror Lake; notified overdue Aug 4; search began Aug 5; Larimer County SAR dog teams and CO National Guard assisted.
